name: relative_entropy_of_entanglement_classical
classification_note: REE stays identically zero on every classical joint because diagonal density matrices are already separable. qutip, cirq, and pennylane are added only as bounded Bell-state reference witnesses on the same 2x2 carrier so this file can contrast classical joints against a nonclassical surface without changing the theorem being tested.

numpy.reason: classical joint algebra, KL divergence, and separable-hull embedding

qutip.reason: Bell-state reference witness on the same 2x2 carrier

cirq.reason: Bell-state circuit witness on the same 2x2 carrier

pennylane.reason: Bell-state statevector witness on the same 2x2 carrier

pytorch.reason: not needed for this classical REE baseline
